title: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Ser. II, Vol. X Index
title_en: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Ser. II, Vol. X Index
author: Ecf
description: Exposition of the Christian Faith. Preface. Prefatory Note. Book I. Prologue. Chapter I. The author distinguishes the faith from the errors of Pagans, Jews, and Heretics, and after explaining the significance of the names “God” and “Lord,” shows clearly the difference of Persons in Unity of Essence. In dividing the Essence, the Arians not only bring in the doctrine of three Gods, but even overthrow the dominion of the Trinity. Chapter II. The Emperor is exhorted to display zeal in the Faith.
